chunks: So fear God and follow me.

key_terms.فَاتَّقُوا: Fear God / Be conscious of God

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command believers to do in Surah The Poets?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a concluding divine mandate where God commands the Prophet to warn his people, linking spiritual piety (Taqwa) directly to obedience of the prophetic messenger. Shia scholarship emphasizes this as a foundational proof for the authority of the Prophet and, by extension, the Imams, viewing obedience to them as inseparable from the fear of God. It underscores that true Taqwa is not merely internal but is manifested through adherence to the divinely appointed leadership.
